solar_panels.evidence: Dark rectangular grid panels on the south-facing roof faces of the central gray-roofed house, including a larger array on the right roof section and another on the left gable.
solar_panels.detail: Roof-mounted arrays on multiple roof faces

detached_structure.evidence: No clear separate outbuilding on the central lot; small items near the back of the house appear to be a deck or patio area attached to the house.

signals.notes: Central house has multiple solar arrays and a long driveway to the north with two vehicles; mature trees, including a dead or bare tree, sit just south of the house.
